title: Bali Tour Package with Kuta and Ubud from India
highlights: Discover Bali's vibrant culture, from exploring Ubud’s lush rice terraces and traditional temples to enjoying Kuta’s lively beach scene and stunning sunsets.
Witness the breathtaking Uluwatu Temple perched on a dramatic cliff, where ancient Balinese architecture meets stunning ocean views and sunset rituals.
Marvel at the iconic Bali Handara Gate, where striking Balinese architecture meets a majestic entrance framed by lush, rolling hills.
Admire the breathtaking sunset at Tanah Lot, where the iconic sea temple stands perched on a rocky outcrop, offering a glimpse into Bali's cultural heritage.
Soak-in the beauty of Tegenungan Waterfall, where cascading waters tumble into a lush green pool, offering a refreshing escape.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Ubud | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport, get transferred to your hotel in Ubud. Post check-in, enjoy your day at leisure, where you can explore the ancient Goa Gajah Temple, famed for its intricate carvings, or visit the colorful Bali Bird Park, home to exotic species. Also, you can explore the Waterbom Waterpark and indulge in thrilling rides. Afterwards, you can indulge in shopping at the Ubud Market before returning to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Kintamani Highlighlands with Tegallalang Rice Terraces & Tegenungan Waterfall
days.desc: Today, start your day by boarding your transfer for a Central Bali tour. Begin at the picturesque Tegenungan Waterfall and soak-in its amazing views. Continue to the beautiful Tegallalang Rice Terraces, famous for their iconic tiered fields, and visit the Kintamani Highlands for stunning views of Mount Batur and its caldera. Also, you can sample the unique Luwak coffee before trying the Bali Swing for a thrilling experience. Later, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Bedugul Sightseeing Tour | Transfer to Kuta
days.desc: Post check-out, board your transfer and visit the iconic Handara Gate, celebrated for its stunning scenic views and photo opportunities. Then, proceed to the stunning Ulun Danu Temple on Lake Beratan, where its picturesque shrines reflect in the calm waters. Proceed to explore Tanah Lot Temple, dramatically perched on a sea rock and soak-in its amazing ocean views before getting transferred to Kuta. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and enjoy your comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Water Sports with Uluwatu Temple Tour & Padang Padang Beach
days.desc: In the morning, board your transfer to Tanjung Benoa Beach, where you can indulge in thrilling water sports such as jet skiing, parasailing, and banana boat rides (at your own expense). Next, enjoy a relaxing stroll along Padang Padang Beach's sandy shores, followed by a visit to Uluwatu Temple to witness stunning sunset views. Once there, you can experience the traditional Kecak dance (optional). Later, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.
